Mobile Number:9833855529

Email Address: elton_allien@yahoo.com

Present Address:Mumbai India.



Objective:
Looking forward to work in your prestigiousCompany in a harmonious environment with an opportunity to grow.

Profile Summary:
· A  Legal Manager with over 15 years of experience in Contract Management under various roles ranging from working on a complex contract negotiationsto a trainer on contract management. 
· Trustworthy, honest and hardworking resource that is highly flexible and always looking for new ideas to simplify work so that it can be completed more efficiently. 
· An expert trainer on soft skills due to ability to communicate effectively and draft precisely. 

Work Experience:
· Dighiphoto Entertainment Imaging - BDC Holdings  ( A subsidiary of Thomas Cook India)(March 2017 to Present)
Designation:  Contract Manager 
Department: Legal
	Present CTC:21 LPA	
Job Responsibilities:
· Drafting of contracts.
· Vetting of contracts
· Drafting of notices and other documents. 
· Getting approvals to get the contracts executed.
· Negotiating the terms of the contracts.
· Legal advice. 
· Creating summaries of the contracts.
· Uploading the contracts on a Contact Management tool.
· Managing the contracts.

· Revenue Sharing Agreements for souvenir photography and school photography.
· Software license Agreements.
· AR content supply Agreements. 
· Consultancy Agreements for Manpower.
· Payroll and Employee Offer Letter Agreements.
· Procurement Agreements for construction.
· Procurement Agreements for Restaurants.
· Internet/Broadband related Agreements.

· Litigation Management

Department: Contract Management
	CTC: 7.90	
Job Responsibilities:
· Drafting of contracts.
· Getting approvals to get the contracts executed.
· Negotiating the terms of the contract.
· Creating summaries of the contract.
· Uploading the contracts on the Contact Management tool.
· Managing the contracts. 

	Types of contracts worked upon in Accenture
· 	Telecom Agreements for a major Telecom player in USA. 








· Infosys BPO Limited (June 2012 to August 2014)
Designation:  Senior Process Specialist
Departments:  Contract Management and Managing Document Review 
		
Job Responsibilities:

· Worked on a contract management project relating to the Banking industry. Worked on the pilot project and was selected by the client to work full time on the project. Successfully got the project running.

· Worked on various mock litigation document projects and other assignments for improving accuracy and attention to detail. 

	Types of contracts worked upon at Infosys
· 	Procurement related contracts.

Department: Mindcrest University

Training
· Responsible for training new batches as well as the existing employees on contract management, basics of contract abstraction and foundational skills through interactive workshops and assignments.

· Conducting periodic tests for the employees and providing them feedback

LLB (hons)

60%
